target.reason: This was the only nominally positive H6 sensitivity and was concentrated among sparsely sampled species.

observed_statistic.species_level: Spearman correlation between pairwise H1-cell centroid great-circle distance and pairwise colour JSD
observed_statistic.global: equal-species mean across the 188 target species

stricter_null.operation: within each species, permute individual classifiable photo soft four-group colour vectors across the species' observed photo rows; keep each photo row's H1 cell assignment fixed; recompute each species x cell mean colour composition using the original cell photo counts; then recompute cell-pair colour JSD and the species/global statistics
preserves: exact number of classifiable photos per species x H1 cell
stricter_null.breaks: association between individual measured flower colour and geography within species

diagnostic_sensitivities.name: pair_count_weighted_global_mean
diagnostic_sensitivities.weight: number of H1 cell pairs per species

diagnostic_sensitivities.name: reliable_n10_cells5_morphs2_frame
diagnostic_sensitivities.role: negative-control replay of the H6 primary frame under the stricter photo-level null

interpretation_rule.if_target_remains_p_lt_0_05: The sparse-frame signal survives a null that preserves per-cell photo counts; it remains exploratory because the H6 reliable primary frame was non-significant.
interpretation_rule.if_target_becomes_p_ge_0_05: The sparse-frame signal is not robust to photo-level exchangeability and should be treated as a cell-support/null-construction artifact candidate.

claim_ceiling: H6b is a robustness diagnostic of one post hoc H6 sensitivity. It cannot convert that sensitivity into a preregistered or primary biological result, and it cannot support a shared boundary, climate mechanism, adaptation, selection, pigment mechanism, or pollinator mechanism claim.
